coupling_analysis.interpretation: Residuals are descriptive for the compromised box. Backbone Karplus calibration partly uses GB3; this is not an independent holdout.

periodic_image_audit.scope: Every 1 ns production snapshot (50 per replica), exact translated-protein atom distances for lattice coefficients -2 through 2. Bonds checked intact in stored coordinates. Full 10 ps frame coverage and electrostatic finite-size convergence are not assessed.

correction: Current ordinary OpenMM/OpenFF preparation defaults use 2 nm OpenMM padding. The benchmark includes explicit protein-image inspection of all saved frames. Larger conformational changes may require larger cells; electrostatic finite-size convergence is a separate question.

replicas.scope: Exact closest protein atom to translated protein copy in selected saved frames, before fitting, after whole-molecule reconstruction. Includes hydrogens. Requires one connected protein. Unsaved/intervening frames, separate ligands and electrostatic finite-size convergence need separate assessment.
